# Sharkings Interiors & Exteriors

> Top Interior Designers in Madurai. Leading Interior Design Firm, Interior Work Contractor & Modular Kitchen Specialist with Flagship Experience Centres in Madurai & Ramanathapuram (Ramnad), serving South Tamil Nadu, all of Tamil Nadu & South India since 2010.

## Overview
Sharkings Interiors & Exteriors is a premier, full-service residential and commercial interior design studio, modular kitchen manufacturer, and turnkey interior work contractor. We are the top interior designers in Madurai, delivering the best interior design in Madurai and Ramanathapuram. Our primary flagship ateliers are located in Madurai and Ramanathapuram, with extensive turnkey interior work execution across South Tamil Nadu (Sivagangai, Virudhunagar, Theni, Dindigul, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi, Kanyakumari) and statewide throughout Tamil Nadu and South India.

## Primary Services
- **Modular Kitchen Design**: Acrylic, Laminate, PVC, and Marine Plywood waterproof modular kitchens (L-shape, U-shape, Parallel, Island, Straight).
- **Home Interiors**: Complete living room hall designs, TV cabinets, false ceilings with LED profile lighting, master bedroom interior suites.
- **Modular Wardrobes**: Sliding wardrobes, lacquered glass wardrobes, walk-in closets, hinged doors.
- **Commercial & Office Design**: Retail stores, beauty salons, spas, corporate offices, glass partitions, reception areas.
- **Exterior ACP Elevation**: Front elevation designs, ACP sheet cladding, HPL panels, exterior louvers, glass facades.
- **Container Architecture**: Custom shipping container homes, container cafes, modular office spaces.

## Geographical Service Tiers
1. **Tier 1 (Primary Hubs)**: Madurai District (Villapuram, Anna Nagar, KK Nagar, SS Colony, Bypass Road, Kalavasal, Tallakulam, Pudur, Sellur, Goripalayam, Melur, Tirumangalam, Usilampatti) & Ramanathapuram District (Ramnad, Rameswaram, Paramakudi, Kilakarai, Devipattinam, Mudukulathur, Kamuthi, Sayalgudi, Mandapam).
2. **Tier 2 (South Tamil Nadu Coverage)**: Sivagangai, Karaikudi, Virudhunagar, Aruppukottai, Sivakasi, Rajapalayam, Theni, Dindigul, Tirunelveli, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi, Kanyakumari.
3. **Tier 3 (Statewide Tamil Nadu & South India)**: Turnkey villa interiors, factory-made modular kitchen shipments, and commercial project installations across all districts of Tamil Nadu and South India.
